title: The OnlyJugs Pack
description: This is a modpack used for the OnlyJugs server. It adds mostly QoL and performance related mods.
body:
## About
The OnlyJugs Pack is a modpack for the OnlyJugs server. It contains mostly smaller QoL mods, but also contains the usual performance mods to make the game more playable. The primary purpose of this modpack is to be an easy entry for people interested in playing on the OnlyJugs server, but of course it is up to you to play on it or alone/on another server!

## Gameplay
The modpack contains mostly small QoL mods so the game still feels vanilla like with the exception of Jugs' Calories which fundamentally changes how survival mode is played on a day to day basis.

## Features
- QoL mods to make certain areas of the game more engaging to play with
- Survival needs to take care of in order to survive
- A server wide trade system to trade with other players
